verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents REST and GraphQL APIs for managing products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically. Supporting docs cover OAuth-based store, app, and account credentials, scoped API accounts, an in-browser Request Runner, API clients, sandboxes and trial stores, and an llms.txt with agent instructions. A secondhand community remark about API throttling is not concrete enough to dispute this; missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability and coverage.
